verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents monitors that automatically check connected systems such as AWS, Azure and GCP against control requirements. A Monitors page lets you assess system health and investigate violations, and the integrations page describes continuous compliance monitors that alert you to violations, with the dashboard flagging controls that need attention. This covers the core of continuous automated testing that surfaces failing controls before audit time. Missing for 10: any documented test cadence or alert latency backing the 'within hours' claim, detail on the scope or number of automated tests, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
